# Load initial Models

## Load Models & Data

```{r}
library(CPTtorch)
library(ACED)
library(torch)
library(parallel)
library(redux)
data(ACED)
data(FullACED)
```

## Build Proficiency Model

Set a canonical order for the proficiency variables.

```{r}
canonicalOrder <- FullACED.omega$Node
profStates <- c("High","Med","Low")
obsStates <- c("Correct","Incorrect")
```

Generate CPTs for the proficiency models.
I will use a shortcut here as I know that all models are Compensatory-Normal with either 0 or 1 parent.
Moreover, alpha = 1 for all of them.

Data that needs to be passed to the sub-processes

* DATA -- The response data
* QQ -- The Q-matrix
* OMEGA -- The Omega Matrix
* FACTORS -- The list of proficiency factors
* EMS -- The list of evidence models
* STATLIST -- The list of reporting statistics

```{r}
profFactors <- lapply(1:nrow(FullACED.omega),\(prof) {
  child <- FullACED.omega$Node[prof]
  print(child)
  parents <- canonicalOrder[sapply(FullACED.omega[prof,canonicalOrder],
                                  isTRUE)]
  tvals <- rep(list(profStates),length(parents))
  if (length(tvals) > 0L) {
    names(tvals) <- parents
    cpt <- CPT_Model$new("CompensatoryGR","Normal",tvals,profStates)
  } else {
    cpt <- CPT_Model$new("Center","Normal",tvals,profStates)
  }
  cpt$child <- child
  if (length(parents) > 0L) {
    cpt$aMat <- torch_ones(1,1,device=CPTtorch_device())
  }
  cpt$bMat <- torch_tensor(matrix(FullACED.omega$Intercept[prof],1,1),
                           device=CPTtorch_device())
  cpt$linkScale <- torch_tensor(sqrt(1-FullACED.omega$R2[prof]^2),
                                device=CPTtorch_device())
  cpt$setProfOrder(canonicalOrder)
  cpt
})
names(profFactors) <- canonicalOrder
FACTORS <- profFactors
```

Build up an omega matrix

```{r}
omega <- as.matrix(FullACED.omega[,canonicalOrder])
row.names(omega) <- canonicalOrder
diag(omega) <- TRUE
OMEGA<-omega
diag(omega)
```



## Build Evidence Models

We need to use `task2em` to decode which EM goes with which task.


```{r}
evidenceModels <- lapply(1:nrow(FullACED.task2em), \(itask) {
  task <- FullACED.task2em$Task[itask]
  print(task)
  iem <- match(FullACED.task2em$EM[itask],FullACED.QQ$Model)
  parents <- canonicalOrder[sapply(FullACED.QQ[iem,canonicalOrder],
                                  isTRUE)]
  tvals <- rep(list(profStates),length(parents))
  if (length(tvals) > 0L) names(tvals) <- parents
  cpt <- CPT_Model$new("CompensatoryGR","GradedResponse",tvals,obsStates)
  cpt$child <- task
  if (length(parents) > 0L) {
    aa <- matrix(as.numeric(FullACED.QQ[iem,paste0("A.",parents)]),nrow=1)
   ## print(aa)
    cpt$aMat <- torch_tensor(aa, device=CPTtorch_device())
  }
  cpt$bMat <- torch_tensor(matrix(FullACED.QQ$B[iem],1,1),
                           device=CPTtorch_device())

  cpt$setProfOrder(canonicalOrder)
  cpt
  
})
names(evidenceModels) <- FullACED.task2em$Task
EMS <- evidenceModels
```

```{r}
longQ <- sapply(1:nrow(FullACED.task2em), \(itask) {
  iem <- match(FullACED.task2em$EM[itask],FullACED.QQ$Model)
  sapply(FullACED.QQ[iem,canonicalOrder],isTRUE)
}) |> t()
dim(longQ)
rownames(longQ) <- FullACED.task2em$Task
QQ <- longQ
```



## Build Statistics

```{r}
nodes <- lapply(unique(FullACED.stats$Node),\(n) {
  print(n)
  node <- Node$new(n,profStates)
  node
})
names(nodes) <- unique(FullACED.stats$Node)
stats <- lapply(1:nrow(FullACED.stats),\(irow) {
 stat <- Statistic$new(FullACED.stats$Name[irow],
                 sub("Pnode","",FullACED.stats$Fun[irow]),
                  nodes[[FullACED.stats$Node[irow]]])
 stat$setProfOrder(canonicalOrder)
 stat
})
names(stats) <- lapply(stats,\(s) s$name)
STATLIST <- stats
```

## Massage data

There are a couple of demographic variables in ACED.items, and data are coded 0,1; not 2,1.

```{r}
ACED.data <- as.matrix(2-ACED.items[,-(1:3)])
rownames(ACED.data) <- ACED.items$AltID
DATA <- ACED.data
```


## Set OPTIONS

```{r}
OPTIONS <- list(
  maxit=100L,  ## Maximum EM Loops
  mit=100L,    ## Maximum Inner Mstep
  stepit=5L,  ## Number of steps between tests
  tolerance=.0001, ## Stopping criteria for convergence
  progress=1L, ## Print message every X iterations
  log=NULL ## list of parameters to log about
)

```



# Setup Clusters

## Setup Redis

Redis instance

```{r}
rurl <- "redis://localhost:6379"
TRED <- tred$new(rurl)
if (TRUE) {
  TRED$red$FLUSHDB()
}
```

Collections we will use:

* `CPT.prof` -- Proficiency model tensor

* `CPT.`_em_`.`_value_ -- evidence model tensors

* `Dat.`_em_`.`_value_ -- evidence model data

* `Dat.`_profvar_ -- proficiency model data

* `lp` -- log posterior


## Build Proficiency Model

```{r}
prof <- buildProficiencies(FACTORS,TRED)
```

## Generate CPTs for evidence models


```{r}
lapply(EMS,\(cpt) {TRED$SETCHUNKS(cpt)})
```

## Setup Clusters

```{r}
nstudents <- nrow(ACED.data)
cl <- makeCluster(detectCores()-2)
clusterCall(cl,\(){library(CPTtorch)})
clusterExport(cl,"rurl")
clusterCall(cl,\(){TRED <<- tred$new(rurl)})
clusterExport(cl,c("DATA","STATLIST","OMEGA","QQ","FACTORS","EMS","OPTIONS"))
```

# Scoring


```{r}
scores <- parLapply(cl,1:nstudents,scoreStats) |>
  purrr::list_rbind()
row.names(scores) <- row.names(DATA)
```




# EM Algorithm



```{r}
EMloop(cl,DATA,EMS,OPTIONS,TRED)
```
